Privacy Policy.

How enquiries sent through this website are handled. Last updated 26 October 2026.

Draft for legal review. This text is a working draft and has not been approved by legal counsel. It must be reviewed before it is relied upon.

What this covers

This page covers personal data you send through this public marketing website. It does not describe data processed inside customer workspaces of the OrgVia application, which is governed by each customer’s agreement with OrgVia.

What we collect

When you use the demo or contact form we receive the name, work email, organization, team size, optional phone number and optional message you enter.

How we use it

We use these details only to reply to your enquiry and arrange a demo. We do not sell them.

Storage and sharing

Enquiries are delivered to the OrgVia team by email through an email delivery provider. [Legal to confirm provider, retention period and storage location.]

Your choices

You can ask us to access or delete the details you sent. [Legal to confirm contact route and applicable law.]

Cookies and analytics

This website does not currently set advertising cookies or load third-party analytics scripts.
